ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, place the right-angle vertex of the triangular cardboard on one side of the ruler. If $\angle 1=20^\circ$ and $\angle 3=30^\circ$, what is the value of $\angle 2$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} As shown in the figure, \\
\(\because\) \(\angle 1=20^\circ\), \(\angle 3=30^\circ\), \\
\(\therefore\) \(\angle 4=\angle 1+\angle 3=20^\circ+30^\circ=50^\circ\), \\
\(\because\) The two sides of the straightedge are parallel to each other, \\
\(\therefore\) \(\angle 2=\angle 4= \boxed{50^\circ}\).
